title: Forza Telemetry
description: Records Forza Horizon's UDP telemetry into Postgres and renders it as a dashboard — a live HUD while you drive, plus session history with synchronised charts and a track map coloured by speed. One Nuxt app, no second process.
approach: Forza broadcasts a fixed binary struct over UDP at around 60 Hz through its built-in "Data Out" feature — no game modding and no memory reading. The app listens for that stream, parses it, stores it and draws it. The UDP listener runs inside the Nuxt server itself, so arming a recording from the dashboard takes effect on the very next packet, and the live HUD streams over SSE without any recording running at all.
